answer.explanation: The request rq-103 for an espresso machine at $890 was flagged for the grant manager and will not be bought unless they approve. It failed the rule "Category allowed" because general office is not an allowable direct cost on a federal grant (grant R21AI182745), as in the NSF OIG audit of UC Davis: unallowable items charged to awards. It cannot be charged to a federal grant, so only the grant manager's approval can buy it.
